#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n >> s;
    
    int prev = -1;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    int index = 0;
    
    for (char c : s) {
        int segmentLength = index - prev - 1;
        switch (c) {
            case '_':
                if (!inside) {
                    if (segmentLength > maxOutside) maxOutside = segmentLength;
                } else if (segmentLength > 0) {
                    insideWords++;
                }
                break;
            case '(':
                inside = true;
                if (segmentLength > maxOutside) maxOutside = segmentLength;
                break;
            case ')':
                inside = false;
                if (segmentLength > 0) insideWords++;
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
        if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
            prev = index;
        }
        index++;
    }
    
    int tailLength = s.length() - prev - 1;
    if (tailLength > maxOutside) maxOutside = tailLength;
    
    std::cout << maxOutside << " " << insideWords << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
